items.title: 并列句与复合句中的省略
items.brief: 省略靠唯一还原把关，共有成分才能删

concept.summary: 省略合法与否只看一条：删掉的成分能否从上下文唯一还原，且还原后句子语法完整。并列句删的是两个分句共有的主语、谓语或助动词，复合句删的是主句已经交代过的谓语或整个从句。补出的成分有两种以上可能时，一律不能省。

sections.h: 先做还原测试，再决定删不删
sections.p: 在空缺处往回找候选成分，能补回的只有一种写法才算合格省略。补回两种都通，说明省略制造了歧义，必须写全。
bullets: 唯一还原：She can sing and dance.（补回 can，只有一种可能）
歧义不可省：Tom likes Mary more than Susan. 既可读作 than Susan does，也可读作 than he likes Susan
省略的是同形同功能的成分，不能只删一半

sections.p: 两个分句主语相同时，第二个主语可删；谓语部分相同时，可只留助动词；系动词相同时，第二个系动词可连同表语一起省略。
bullets: 省主语：He opened the door and walked into the room.
省系动词：The room was clean and tidy.
省谓语只留助动词：He didn't attend the meeting, but he said he would.
共用介词：He is fond of music and painting.

sections.h: 复合句：删主句已交代的谓语或从句
sections.p: 状语从句与比较从句常删掉与主句重复的谓语，只保留主语和助动词；宾语从句与定语从句则常删掉引导词。
bullets: 状语从句：I will help you if I can.
比较从句：The weather is warmer today than yesterday.（补回 it was）
宾语从句省 that：I believe she is right.
定语从句省作宾语的关系代词：The novel you lent me is excellent.

sections.p: 省略必须保证每个分句仍有自己的主语和谓语核心。主语换了、助动词换了、宾语换了，都不能沿用前一分的结构。
bullets: 主语不同，谓语不能省：第二分句必须补出自己的谓语，不能只留表语
助动词形式不同，不能共用：前句用 has finished，后句必须沿用 has
省略后指代不明，必须写全：比较句中出现两个可能的比较对象时不能省

examples.en: He opened the door and walked into the room.
examples.zh: 他打开门，走进了房间。
examples.note: 第二分句与第一分句主语相同，删掉重复的 he，谓语保持并列。

examples.en: The room was clean and tidy.
examples.zh: 房间干净整洁。
examples.note: 两个表语共用系动词 was，第二个 was 省略。

examples.en: I will help you if I can.
examples.zh: 如果我能帮你，我会帮的。
examples.note: 状语从句删掉与主句重复的 help you，只保留情态动词 can。

examples.en: He didn't attend the meeting, but he said he would.
examples.zh: 他没参加会议，但他说过会参加。
examples.note: would 后省略 attend the meeting，助动词承载了整个谓语的意思。

examples.en: She was excited, and her friends also excited.
examples.zh: 她很兴奋，她的朋友们也是。
examples.note: 两个分句主语不同，第二分句缺谓语，应补出 were：her friends were excited too.

examples.en: This is the novel which I borrowed it from the library.
examples.zh: 这就是我从图书馆借的那本小说。
examples.note: 关系代词 which 已作 borrowed 的宾语，从句里再出现 it 就重复了，应删去 it。

pitfalls.wrong: She was tired, and her colleagues also tired.
pitfalls.right: She was tired, and her colleagues were tired too.
pitfalls.why: 第二分句主语换成复数 colleagues，不能沿用第一分句的 was，也不能把系动词整个删掉，否则分句没有谓语。

pitfalls.wrong: This is the novel which I borrowed it from the library.
pitfalls.right: This is the novel which I borrowed from the library.
pitfalls.why: 关系代词 which 在从句中充当 borrowed 的宾语，宾语位置已被占据，再加 it 就是同一个成分出现两次。

pitfalls.wrong: He didn't come, but he said he will.
pitfalls.right: He didn't come, but he said he would.
pitfalls.why: 省略后保留的助动词必须与主句时态一致，said 是过去时，只能用 would，不能用 will。

contrast.diff: 本知识点处理并列与主从结构中共有成分的删除；状语从句省略另有一条硬前提——从句主语与主句主语一致且谓语含 be。

concept.mnemonic: 删之前先补一遍，补得唯一才敢删。

core: 合法省略 = 能从上下文唯一还原 + 还原后语法完整
并列句删共有主语、共有系动词、共有助动词
复合句常删与主句重复的谓语，或删 that 与作宾语的关系代词
主语不同则谓语不能省，助动词形式不同则不能共用
同一成分不能在从句中出现两次：which 已作宾语就不再加 it
review.trigger: 看到 and/but 或从句前有空缺 → 先补回候选成分 → 只有一种补法才保留省略

quickCheck.q: The room was clean and tidy. 省略了什么？
quickCheck.a: 省略了第二个表语前的系动词 was。

quickCheck.q: He didn't come, but he said he will. 错在哪里？
quickCheck.a: said 是过去时，省略后保留的助动词应为 would。

quickCheck.q: 关系代词 which 作宾语时，从句里还能用 it 吗？
quickCheck.a: 不能，宾语位置已被 which 占据，再用 it 就重复了。

drills.stem: The staff have completed the training, and the manager ___.
drills.answer: has too
drills.explain: 前一分句是现在完成时 have completed，后一分句共用 completed the training，只保留助动词；主语 the manager 是单数，助动词用 has。
drills.trap: does too 借了 do，与前面的完成时不对应；has completed too 没有删掉重复的实义动词，省略失效。

drills.stem: He didn't finish the report, but he said he ___ (will).
drills.answer: would
drills.hint: 看主句 said 的时态，再定省略后保留的助动词形式。
drills.explain: 后一分句省略了 finish the report，只留助动词；主句 said 是过去时，助动词须相应用 would，构成过去将来。

drills.stem: This is the camera which I bought it in Japan last year.
drills.answer: This is the camera which I bought in Japan last year.
accept: This is the camera which I bought in Japan last year.
drills.explain: 关系代词 which 在定语从句中作 bought 的宾语，宾语位置已被占据，代词 it 必须删去。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: She can play the violin, and her brother can too.
drills.explain: 两个分句主语不同，因此第二个主语 her brother 必须保留；谓语部分相同，只留助动词 can，再用 too 收尾。

drills.stem: 他去过北京，他父母也去过。
drills.answer: He has been to Beijing, and his parents have too.
drills.explain: 第二分句省略重复的 been to Beijing，只保留助动词 have；主语 parents 是复数，助动词用 have 而不是 has。

drills.stem: She opened the window and ___ the fresh air.
drills.answer: breathed in
drills.explain: and 连接两个并列谓语，共用主语 she；前项 opened 是一般过去时，后项必须同为过去式 breathed in。
drills.trap: to breathe in 把并列谓语降级成目的状语；breathing in 使第二分句失去谓语。

items.title: 状语从句中的省略
items.brief: 主语一致且谓语含 be，才删主语和 be

concept.summary: 状语从句省略要同时满足两个前提：从句主语与主句主语一致，且从句谓语含 be。两条都成立时，把主语和 be 一起删掉，只留连词与剩余部分；缺少任何一条都不能省主语。主语为无人称 it 的 if necessary 一类固定表达是唯一例外。

sections.p: 先找从句主语，再问它是否就是主句主语；再看从句谓语里有没有 be。两个答案都是“是”，才能删。
bullets: 主语一致 + 含 be：While he was waiting for the bus, he read a newspaper. → While waiting for the bus, he read a newspaper.
主语必须一致：从句的逻辑主语要能由主句主语充当，充当不了就不能省
谓语含 be 才能省：When walking 的原形是 When I was walking，be 是构成进行时的助动词
保留主语就必须保留 be：While I was watching TV 中 was 不能删

sections.p: 只有引导状语从句的连词才能保留下来构成省略从句，连词本身不能删。
bullets: 时间：when, while, until, once, whenever
条件：if, unless, whether...or
让步：though, although, even if
方式：as if, as though

sections.h: 主语是 it 的固定表达
sections.p: if necessary / if possible / if any 这类固定表达，从句主语是无人称的 it，与主句主语并不相同，但已经固化成省略式，按整块记。
bullets: If necessary, we can postpone the meeting.
Call me if possible.
There are few errors, if any.
When necessary, the system restarts itself.

sections.p: 省略从句没有自己的主语，独立主格保留自己的主语。看到“名词 + 分词”且名词与主句主语不同，那是独立主格，不是省略。
bullets: 省略：Although tired, she finished the race.（逻辑主语 she）
独立主格：Weather permitting, we will set off tomorrow.（自带主语 weather）
悬垂：从句删去主语后，主句主语必须能充当它的逻辑主语，否则要补出从句主语

examples.en: While waiting for the bus, he read a newspaper.
examples.zh: 等公交车时，他看了一份报纸。
examples.note: 从句主语 he 与主句主语一致，谓语是 was waiting，删去 he was。

examples.en: If necessary, we can change the date.
examples.zh: 如果有必要，我们可以改日期。
examples.note: 固定省略式，完整形式是 If it is necessary。

examples.en: Once published, the book sold well.
examples.zh: 这本书一出版就卖得很好。
examples.note: 从句主语 the book 与主句主语一致，谓语为 was published，删去 it was 后保留过去分词。

examples.en: Though exhausted, she finished the race.
examples.zh: 尽管筋疲力尽，她还是跑完了全程。
examples.note: 让步从句省略 she was，只留形容词 exhausted。

examples.en: While watching TV, the phone rang.
examples.zh: 看电视时，电话响了。
examples.note: 省略后从句的逻辑主语变成主句主语 the phone，电话不会看电视，应补出 I was 或改写主句主语。

examples.en: When walk in the park, I met an old friend.
examples.zh: 在公园散步时，我遇到了一位老朋友。
examples.note: 从句谓语不含 be 时不能删主语，应改为 When walking in the park 或 When I was walking in the park。

pitfalls.wrong: Although being tired, he kept working.
pitfalls.why: 省略只能删主语和 be，不能把 be 改写成 being；从句原本是 although he was tired。

pitfalls.wrong: When compared with his brother, Tom's height is greater.
pitfalls.right: When compared with his brother, Tom is taller.
pitfalls.why: 省略后从句的逻辑主语必须与主句主语一致，Tom's height 不能与 his brother 相比。

pitfalls.wrong: While I watching TV, the phone rang.
pitfalls.right: While I was watching TV, the phone rang.
pitfalls.why: 保留了主语 I，就必须保留谓语中的 be，省略只能成对删除主语和 be。

contrast.withTitle: 并列句与复合句中的省略
contrast.diff: 并列与主从省略靠“共有成分可唯一还原”；状语从句省略另加一条硬前提——主语一致且谓语含 be，两条不满足就只能补全从句。

concept.mnemonic: 同主语、有 be，才能一起删；删完的逻辑主语看主句。

core: 两个前提：从句主语与主句主语一致 + 从句谓语含 be
删的是“主语 + be”，连词必须保留
谓语不含 be 时不能删主语：When walking / When I was walking
主语是 it 的固定式：if necessary / if possible / if any
删完逻辑主语归主句，归不上就是悬垂修饰语
review.trigger: 看到 when/while/if/though + 分词或形容词 → 先补主语和 be → 补出的主语是否等于主句主语

quickCheck.q: While waiting for the bus, the phone rang. 为什么错？
quickCheck.a: 省略后从句的逻辑主语成了 the phone，电话不会等车，应补出 I was。

quickCheck.q: When walk in the park, I met him. 怎么改？
quickCheck.a: 改为 When walking in the park，或补全为 When I was walking in the park。

quickCheck.q: If necessary 的完整形式是什么？
quickCheck.a: If it is necessary，属于主语为 it 的固定省略式。

drills.stem: The documents should be checked again if ___.
drills.answer: necessary
drills.explain: if necessary 是 if it is necessary 的固定省略式，主语 it 与 be 一起删去，只留形容词 necessary 作表语。
drills.trap: it necessary 只删了 be 却保留主语，省略必须成对删除；necessarily 是副词，不能作表语。

drills.stem: When ___ (walk) in the park, I met an old friend of mine.
drills.answer: walking
drills.hint: 从句主语与主句主语同为 I，从句谓语是 was walking。
drills.explain: 从句主语 I 与主句主语一致，谓语含 be（was walking），删去 I was 后剩下现在分词 walking。

drills.stem: While I watching TV, the phone rang.
drills.answer: While I was watching TV, the phone rang.
accept: While I was watching TV, the phone rang.
drills.explain: 从句保留了主语 I，就必须保留谓语中的 be；省略只能把主语和 be 一起删掉，不能只删 be。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: Although tired, she finished the race.
drills.explain: 让步从句的主语与主句主语同为 she，谓语为 was tired，删去 she was 后只留形容词 tired。

drills.stem: 虽然很累，他还是完成了工作。
drills.answer: Though tired, he still finished the work.
drills.explain: 从句为 though he was tired，主语与主句一致且含 be，删去 he was 后保留 tired；不能保留主语却删掉 be。

drills.stem: While ___ for the bus, he read a newspaper.
drills.answer: waiting
drills.explain: 主句主语 he 就是从从句删去的主语，从句谓语为 was waiting，删去 he was 后保留现在分词 waiting。
drills.trap: waited 表被动，与 he 主动等车的逻辑关系不符；wait 和 to wait 都不能跟在 while 后作省略从句。

drills.stem: When comparing with the old model, the new one is much lighter.
drills.answer: When compared with the old model, the new one is much lighter.
accept: When compared with the old model, the new one is much lighter.
drills.explain: 主句主语 the new one 是比较的对象，与 compare 之间是被动关系，省略前的从句是 when it is compared with the old model，须用过去分词。

items.title: 不定式的省略
items.brief: 留 to 还是连 to 一起省，看前面的词

concept.summary: 不定式的省略分两种：只删 to 后面的动词原形、保留 to（承前省略与固定搭配），或连 to 一起删（情态动词、使役动词、感官动词之后）。判定只看前面的词：助动词和形容词后要留 to，情态动词与使役感官动词后不带 to。

sections.h: 留 to 删动词：承前省略
sections.p: 前文已出现同一个不定式时，为避免重复只保留 to。这个 to 必须有先行语，前面找不到被替代的动词，句子就悬空。
bullets: I asked him to help, but he didn't want to.
You may leave early if you want to.
— Will you join us? — I'd love to.
承前省略的 to 不能丢：want 后必须有 to 顶住宾语位置，说 didn't want to

sections.h: 留 to 的固定搭配
sections.p: 这些结构里的 to 已经和前面的词粘成一个单位，省略时不能把 to 丢掉。
bullets: have to / ought to / used to / be able to / be going to
I don't have to go, but she has to.
He didn't pass the test, though he ought to have.
— Can you swim? — I used to.

sections.h: 连 to 一起省：情态、使役、感官
sections.p: 这些位置本来就不出现 to，所以不是“省略 to”，而是结构本身要求动词原形。
bullets: 情态动词：can / must / should / may + 动词原形
使役动词：make / let / have + 宾语 + 动词原形
感官动词：see / hear / watch / feel + 宾语 + 动词原形
固定说法：had better do / would rather do / why not do

sections.h: but 与 except 后的 to
sections.p: but / except 前出现实义动词 do 的任何形式时，后面的不定式省 to；前面没有 do 时，to 保留。
bullets: He did nothing but complain about the food.
She had no choice but to wait.
There is nothing to do but wait.

examples.en: I asked him to help, but he didn't want to.
examples.zh: 我请他帮忙，但他不愿意。
examples.note: 承前省略 help，只保留 to 作 want 的宾语。

examples.en: You don't have to come, but you ought to.
examples.zh: 你不必来，但你应该来。
examples.note: ought to 是固定搭配，省略 come 后 to 必须保留。

examples.en: They made him wait outside for an hour.
examples.zh: 他们让他在外面等了一个小时。
examples.note: 使役动词 make 后的宾补用动词原形，不带 to。

examples.en: He did nothing but complain about the food.
examples.zh: 他除了抱怨饭菜什么也没做。
examples.note: but 前有实义动词 did，后面的不定式省 to。

examples.en: He made me to clean the whole kitchen.
examples.zh: 他让我把整个厨房打扫干净。
examples.note: make 是使役动词，宾补不带 to，应改为 made me clean。

examples.en: I asked her to stay, but she didn't want.
examples.zh: 我请她留下，但她不愿意。
examples.note: want 是及物动词，省略后必须保留 to 作宾语，应改为 didn't want to。

examples.en: He had better to see a doctor.
examples.zh: 他最好去看医生。
examples.note: had better 后直接接动词原形，to 不出现，应改为 had better see。

pitfalls.wrong: You can leave now if you want.
pitfalls.right: You can leave now if you want to.
pitfalls.why: want 后需要宾语，省略 leave now 后必须用 to 顶住这个位置，否则 want 缺宾语。

pitfalls.wrong: I have to finish it today, but he doesn't have.
pitfalls.right: I have to finish it today, but he doesn't have to.
pitfalls.why: have to 是固定搭配，省略 finish it 后 to 仍属于这个搭配，不能跟着动词一起删。

pitfalls.wrong: She had nothing to do but to wait for the result.
pitfalls.right: She had nothing to do but wait for the result.
pitfalls.why: but 前出现了实义动词 do，其后的不定式省 to；前面没有 do 时才保留 to，如 had no choice but to wait。

contrast.withTitle: 不定式符号 to 的保留与省略
contrast.diff: 本点处理“整个不定式短语被省略后留不留 to”；符号 to 与介词 to 的词性区分属于非谓语部分。

concept.mnemonic: 情态使役感官不带 to，助动词形容词后 to 站住。

core: 承前省略只留 to：I asked him to help, but he didn't want to.
固定搭配的 to 不能丢：have to / ought to / used to / be able to
情态动词与使役感官动词后本就不用 to，直接接原形
had better / would rather / why not 后接动词原形
but / except 前有 do 才省 to，没有 do 就保留 to
review.trigger: 看到 want / love / have to 后突然断句 → 问前面有没有被替代的不定式 → 有就补 to

quickCheck.q: I asked her to stay, but she didn't want. 错在哪里？
quickCheck.a: want 缺宾语，承前省略必须保留 to，改为 didn't want to。

quickCheck.q: make 后面的宾补要 to 吗？
He did nothing but complain. 为什么用 complain？
quickCheck.a: but 前有实义动词 did，后面的不定式省 to。

drills.stem: You don't have to attend the meeting, but I ___.
drills.answer: have to
drills.explain: 省略 attend the meeting 后，have to 这个固定搭配中的 to 必须保留；主语是 I，用 have to。
drills.trap: have 单独使用会变成实义动词“拥有”，句意被改写成“我有一场会议”；must to 本身不成立。

drills.stem: He had nothing to do but ___ (wait) for the result.
drills.answer: wait
drills.hint: but 前出现了实义动词 do。
drills.explain: but 前的 nothing to do 含实义动词 do，其后的不定式省略 to，直接用动词原形 wait。

drills.stem: The teacher made us to rewrite the essay.
drills.answer: The teacher made us rewrite the essay.
accept: The teacher made us rewrite the essay.
drills.explain: make 是使役动词，宾语补足语用不带 to 的不定式，to 必须删去。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: He did nothing but complain about the noise.
drills.explain: but 前有实义动词 did，后面接省 to 的不定式 complain，构成 nothing to do but do 的结构。

drills.stem: 他不想去，但他不得不去。
drills.answer: He didn't want to go, but he had to.
drills.explain: 后一分句省略 go，have to 中的 to 作为固定搭配必须保留；must 后不能加 to。

drills.stem: Rather than ___ the train, she walked home.
drills.answer: take
drills.explain: rather than 后接与主句谓语平行的动词原形，与 walked 形成对比，不带 to。
drills.trap: to take 是受 rather than 可接不定式的说法误导；rather than 后接不定式时要省 to，与前面的动词形式保持一致。

items.title: 习惯性省略
items.brief: 固化的省略式整块记，正式文体不照搬

concept.summary: 习惯性省略是已经固化成型的省略式，不靠现场推导，而靠整块记忆。三类最常用：口语对话中省主语与助动词、告示与标题中省冠词与 be、固定框架中省掉整个从句。它们各有确定的使用场景，正式书面句中不能照搬。

sections.h: 口语对话：省主语与助动词
sections.p: 对话双方共享语境，主语和助动词可以不说；这类省略只出现在口语和非正式文字里。
bullets: Got a minute?（省 Have you）
Sounds good.（省 It）
Hope to see you soon.（省 I）
Why not ask her?（省 do you）

sections.h: 告示、标题与标注：省冠词与 be
sections.p: 空间有限，冠词、be、甚至主语都删去，只留实词。新闻标题还常省助动词。
bullets: Tickets available at the door.（省冠词与 are）
Photos by Li Ming.（图片署名，只留名词短语）
Keep out of reach of children.（说明书祈使句）
Beijing, May 5 (Xinhua)（新闻电头）

sections.h: 固定框架：省掉整个从句
sections.p: 这类结构里的省略部分无法逐词补出，只能整体记住搭配形式。
bullets: as...as possible：Come as soon as possible.（省 it is）
if any / if ever：There are few errors, if any.
if so / if not：Are you free? If so, let's meet.
if necessary / if possible：Call me if possible.

sections.p: 正式书面语要求主语和限定动词齐全；把口语省略式写进论文、公文、商务邮件会显得随意甚至造成歧义。
bullets: 正式书面语要补主语：口语的 Sounds good 在书面中写作 It sounds good
省略主语只限口语与非正式文字，合同、论文、公文的分句必须有明确主语

examples.en: Got a minute?
examples.zh: 有空吗？
examples.note: 口语省去 Have you，只剩实义部分。

examples.en: Tickets available at the door.
examples.zh: 门口有票。
examples.note: 告示省去冠词与 are，保留核心名词和形容词。

examples.en: Come as soon as possible.
examples.zh: 请尽快来。
examples.note: as...as possible 是固定省略式，完整形式含 it is。

examples.en: There are few errors in the essay, if any.
examples.zh: 这篇文章即使有错误也很少。
examples.note: if any 后省 there are，与前面的半否定 few 呼应。

examples.en: There are few errors in the essay, if some.
examples.zh: 这篇文章即使有错误也很少。
examples.note: 固定说法是 if any，用于否定或半否定语境，不能换成 if some。

examples.en: Please call me as soon as possibly.
examples.zh: 请尽快给我打电话。
examples.note: 固定形式是 as soon as possible，possible 是形容词作表语，possibly 不能替换。

pitfalls.wrong: If possibly, send me the file today.
pitfalls.right: If possible, send me the file today.
pitfalls.why: 固定省略式源自 if it is possible，possible 作表语；possibly 是副词，不能占据表语位置。

pitfalls.wrong: There is little water left, if some.
pitfalls.right: There is little water left, if any.
pitfalls.why: if any 是固定省略式，专门与 little、few 这类半否定词呼应，if some 不是固定搭配。

pitfalls.wrong: Sounds good, so we will start tomorrow.
pitfalls.right: It sounds good, so we will start tomorrow.
pitfalls.why: 省主语是口语特征，正式书面分句必须出现主语 it，否则读者无法确认是谁在评价。

contrast.diff: 状语从句省略有可推导的前提（主语一致 + 含 be）；习惯性省略是固化形式，只能按场景整块使用。

concept.mnemonic: 口语省主语，告示省冠词，固定框架整块背。

core: 习惯性省略是固化形式，不靠现场推导
口语可省主语与助动词：Got a minute? / Sounds good.
告示与标题省冠词和 be：Tickets available at the door.
固定框架：as...as possible / if any / if so / if necessary
正式书面语必须补全主语和限定动词
review.trigger: 在告示或对话里看到没有主语的句子 → 先确认文体 → 正式文体一律补全

quickCheck.q: as soon as possible 能说成 as soon as possibly 吗？
quickCheck.a: 不能，固定形式是 as...as possible。

quickCheck.q: few 后面的固定省略式是 if any 还是 if some？
论文里能写 Sounds good 吗？
quickCheck.a: 不能，应补出主语写成 It sounds good。

drills.stem: If ___, please send me the file before Friday.
drills.answer: possible
drills.explain: if possible 是 if it is possible 的固定省略式，主语 it 与 be 一起删去，possible 作表语。
drills.trap: it possible 只删了 be 却保留主语，省略必须成对删除；possibly 是副词，不能作表语。

drills.stem: There are few mistakes in your essay, if ___.
drills.answer: any
drills.hint: 前半句用了半否定词 few。
drills.explain: if any 是固定省略式，与 few、little 这类半否定词呼应，完整形式是 if there are any。

drills.stem: Sounds good, so we will adopt the proposal.
drills.answer: It sounds good, so we will adopt the proposal.
accept: It sounds good, so we will adopt the proposal.
drills.explain: 省主语只适用于口语对话，正式书面分句必须补出主语 it，否则 sounds 的主语缺失。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: Come as soon as possible.
drills.explain: as...as possible 是固定省略框架，中间放形容词或副词原级 soon。

drills.stem: 如有必要，我们可以改期。
drills.answer: If necessary, we can change the date.
drills.explain: if necessary 是 if it is necessary 的固定省略式，主语 it 与 be 一起删去。
